# Commands

[← Back to index](README.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/_groups.md for the groups and docs/commands/_notes/<name>.md for each page. -->

The plugin ships **29** `/fc:*` commands on Claude Code. Codex has a matching `$fc-<name>` skill for each (`/fc:spec` → `$fc-spec`). The 18 project tasks load `ai-factory/tasks/<name>.md` from your repo, so they need an adopted workspace; 4 more are shortcut or deprecated names that run one of them; the other 7 are plugin-level and work in any repo.

Descriptions and arguments come from the frontmatter of `commands/*.md` and, for a project task without an argument hint of its own, its task template. `<…>` is required, `[…]` optional. Each command links to its help page.

| Group | Commands |
|---|---|
| [Entry and resume](#entry-and-resume) | `start`, `continue`, `state`, `current` |
| [Setup and maintenance](#setup-and-maintenance) | `adopt-sdlc`, `doctor`, `sync-sdlc`, `fleet`, `setup-tracker`, `setup-knowledge` |
| [Decide before building](#decide-before-building) | `analyse`, `ba` (shortcut), `analyze` (shortcut), `design`, `adr`, `explore`, `scout` (shortcut), `risk` |
| [Specify and plan](#specify-and-plan) | `spec`, `plan` |
| [Build and verify](#build-and-verify) | `test`, `run`, `loop`, `fix`, `chore`, `quick` |
| [Review and hand off](#review-and-hand-off) | `review`, `check` (deprecated), `report` |

## Entry and resume

| Command | Arguments | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`/fc:start`](commands/start.md) | `<change and expected result>` | Project task | Choose an existing workflow for a change request |
| [`/fc:continue`](commands/continue.md) | `<delivery id>` | Project task | Resume a planned delivery — explain its next evidence-backed action and run that one task |
| [`/fc:state`](commands/state.md) | none | Plugin-level command | List this repo's outstanding specs and plans, each outstanding plan shown with its incomplete steps — only specs with --specs, only plans with --plans, one spec with its plans with --spec &lt;id&gt; — or show one contract delivery's status with --delivery &lt;id&gt; |
| [`/fc:current`](commands/current.md) | `[--spec <id>]` | Plugin-level command | List only the plans in progress — started but not finished — with each plan's progress and the next step to pick up; --spec &lt;id&gt; narrows it to one spec's plans |

## Setup and maintenance

| Command | Arguments | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`/fc:adopt-sdlc`](commands/adopt-sdlc.md) | `[owner]` | Plugin-level command | Add a self-contained ai-factory workspace without changing root files |
| [`/fc:doctor`](commands/doctor.md) | none | Plugin-level command | Report what is wrong with this repo's ai-sdlc setup, and the command that fixes each thing |
| [`/fc:sync-sdlc`](commands/sync-sdlc.md) | none | Plugin-level command | Inspect workspace drift; generate host pointers only when explicitly requested |
| [`/fc:fleet`](commands/fleet.md) | `[focus, or blank for the whole map]` | Project task | Fill in ai-factory/docs/fleet.md — the service map the architect reads — by detecting what it can and asking you the rest |
| [`/fc:setup-tracker`](commands/setup-tracker.md) | `[site url]` | Plugin-level command | Configure this repo's tracker, confirm it with you, and prove it resolves a real key |
| [`/fc:setup-knowledge`](commands/setup-knowledge.md) | `[server name]` | Plugin-level command | Optionally declare an external documentation source, confirm it with you, and prove it answers |

## Decide before building

| Command | Arguments | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`/fc:analyse`](commands/analyse.md) | `<feature description> \| lean\|questions <feature description> \| review\|update\|explain <analysis path> […]` | Project task | Turn a feature description into a business-analysis pack — objectives, scope, actors and permissions, use cases, requirements, rules, data, stories with acceptance criteria, test scenarios — facts, assumptions and open questions kept apart; before any spec |
| [`/fc:ba`](commands/ba.md) | `<feature description> \| lean\|questions <feature description> \| review\|update\|explain <analysis path> […]` | Project task | Shortcut for /fc:analyse — Turn a feature description into a business-analysis pack — objectives, scope, actors and permissions, use cases, requirements, rules, data, stories with acceptance criteria, test scenarios — facts, assumptions and open questions kept apart; before any spec |
| [`/fc:analyze`](commands/analyze.md) | `<feature description> \| lean\|questions <feature description> \| review\|update\|explain <analysis path> […]` | Project task | Shortcut for /fc:analyse — Turn a feature description into a business-analysis pack — objectives, scope, actors and permissions, use cases, requirements, rules, data, stories with acceptance criteria, test scenarios — facts, assumptions and open questions kept apart; before any spec |
| [`/fc:design`](commands/design.md) | `<capability> \| review <plan path>` | Project task | Decide where a capability belongs across services, what contract it exposes and who owns the data — before any spec |
| [`/fc:adr`](commands/adr.md) | `<decision in one sentence>` | Project task | Record one architectural decision as an ADR in ai-factory/adr/ |
| [`/fc:explore`](commands/explore.md) | `<feature request>` | Project task | Explore a feature request — read the code, present 2–4 implementation approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation, before any spec |
| [`/fc:scout`](commands/scout.md) | `<feature request>` | Project task | Shortcut for /fc:explore — Explore a feature request — read the code, present 2–4 implementation approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation, before any spec |
| [`/fc:risk`](commands/risk.md) | `<spec or plan path \| working tree \| branch \| diff path>` | Project task | Assess one spec, plan or change for security threats and delivery risk — findings with severity, status, evidence and mitigation — recorded in one committed file under ai-factory/risks/ |

## Specify and plan

| Command | Arguments | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`/fc:spec`](commands/spec.md) | `<feature request>` | Project task | Draft a feature spec with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria |
| [`/fc:plan`](commands/plan.md) | `<spec path>` | Project task | Turn a spec into an ordered implementation plan with checkboxes |

## Build and verify

| Command | Arguments | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`/fc:test`](commands/test.md) | `<spec path> red\|gaps` | Project task | Write acceptance tests from the spec's acceptance criteria, independently of the implementation |
| [`/fc:run`](commands/run.md) | `<plan path> <step>` | Project task | Implement one step of a plan |
| [`/fc:loop`](commands/loop.md) | `<plan ID or path> [--max-parallel 1-8] [--step-timeout <minutes>]` | Project task | Run every unticked step of a plan until done, independent steps in parallel, then one review |
| [`/fc:fix`](commands/fix.md) | `<bug: symptom and how to reproduce>` | Project task | Reproduce a bug with a failing test, then fix it minimally |
| [`/fc:chore`](commands/chore.md) | `<what to change>` | Project task | Small maintenance change with tests and no behaviour drift |
| [`/fc:quick`](commands/quick.md) | `<change and expected result>` | Project task | Make a small, well-understood change with focused verification |

## Review and hand off

| Command | Arguments | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`/fc:review`](commands/review.md) | `[working-tree\|branch\|supplied diff and context]` | Project task | Review the selected change, including uncommitted work by default |
| [`/fc:check`](commands/check.md) | `[working-tree\|branch\|supplied diff and context]` | Project task | Deprecated — use /fc:review. Runs the review task under its old name |
| [`/fc:report`](commands/report.md) | `<delivery id>` | Project task | Generate the local completion report for one delivery — status, evidence, review and follow-up |
